Date: Jun 9 - Jun 12, 2026
* 🔴 (Jun 9) User stated financial goals: allocate 15% monthly income to emergency fund, pay off credit card debt within 6 months ($400/mo), and refused to share bank login credentials.
* 🟡 (Jun 9) Compiled HVAC tax deduction docs (system installed 05-12-2026) and sent spending/debt summaries.
* 🔴 (Jun 12) User stated they want to reallocate 10% of discretionary spend to a travel fund.
* 🟡 (Jun 12) Compiled mortgage refinance options identifying $120/mo potential savings.

Date: Jun 15 - Jun 18, 2026
* 🔴 (Jun 15) User added $200/mo to emergency fund contribution and inquired about student loan refinancing (2.8% rate saves $35/mo) and 0% APR card terms.
* 🟡 (Jun 15) Set up electricity auto-pay with a $15/mo early payment discount.
* 🔴 (Jun 18) User increased 401(k) contribution by 2% (4% match) and set up $500/mo recurring transfer to Horizon Savings (1.5% APY).
* ✅ (Jun 18) Confirmed traditional IRA rollover maintains tax deduction eligibility.

Date: Jun 22 - Jun 26, 2026
* 🔴 (Jun 22) User set emergency fund target to $10,000 (credit score 760) and explored a HELOC (3.5% APR) for a business startup.
* 🔴 (Jun 26) User increased 401(k) rate to 12% and stated car loan has 38 months remaining.
* ✅ (Jun 26) Confirmed Roth IRA conversion tax impact ($3,500) and compiled mortgage interest deduction report.
* 🟡 (Jun 26) Analyzed VestorPrime and AutoGrow robo-advisors; confirmed AutoGrow supports ESG portfolios with a follow-up call pending.
</observations>

<current-task>
- Primary: Follow up with the user regarding AutoGrow ESG robo-advisor options and the scheduled 20:30 strategy session.
- Secondary (Waiting for user): Mortgage/student loan refinancing decisions, HELOC business startup funding, and debt payoff tracking.
</current-task>
